gates.requirement: Every originating requirement has evidence-backed passed, explicitly accepted deferred, or externally blocked status; acceptance alone is not passage.
The 24-file research package (23 content artefacts plus its integrity manifest) retains its recorded hashes and 40 successful checks, and the Claude evaluation is separately integrity-bound.
OKF 0.2, YAML-LD semantic round-trip, JSON-LD/RDF equivalence, SHACL, JSON Schema and vocabulary competency checks pass.
All publicly accessible in-scope source routes have frozen acquisition evidence and exact denominators; restricted routes are declared.
The official effects graph is non-empty and queryable, live reconciliation is evidenced, and every eligible record has a recorded enrichment outcome.
A clean clone reproduces identical semantic and byte digests with pinned dependencies.
Chrome, Firefox and WebKit journeys pass, keyboard operation is verified, and automated WCAG checks have no serious or critical violations.
Initial transfer, cold and warm search latency, and browser-memory limits pass on the frozen candidate.
Pages, raw, archive and compatibility entry points pass unauthenticated smoke tests; the YAML-LD MIME exception remains explicit.
Secret, dependency, content-injection, XML/XXE, archive-bomb, SSRF and privacy checks pass on the frozen candidate.

The corpus-bound release suite has independently verified gold evidence, citation-bearing executed answers, zero hard failures, at least 85/100 for every critical persona/task family, and two successful held-out challenge passes.
The final release report records relationship composition, coverage, freshness, gaps, licence/access escalations, evaluation results and model cost.
The release candidate is promoted without rebuilding and its public artefact digests equal the validated candidate digests.
